description: This file defines a utility class WidgetUtil for Android applications, focusing on ensuring compatibility when creating PendingIntents across different Android API levels. It provides a method to set appropriate flags depending on the device's API version.

classes.name: WidgetUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for compatible PendingIntent flag settings based on Android API levels.

methods.name: pendingIntentFlagCompat
methods.description: Adjusts PendingIntent flags to ensure compatibility across different Android API levels, adding FLAG_IMMUTABLE for API 34+ and FLAG_MUTABLE for API 31+.
